rule: Five fixed sensor coordinates chosen before extracting values; no intensity-based selection
log_rule: binary64 log(max(recorded pre-floor FP32 intensity, effective sensor floor)); analysis only
scope: Sparse retained traces and their emitted events; complete same-input comparisons use all pixels and hashes above. Probes can miss localized effects. Full optical archives remain local and can be regenerated with the matrix commands.
